representativeSnapshot.kind: production-like disposable database with feature_flags present and empty

rowCountQueries: select key from public.feature_flags where key like 'post_styles_%' order by key
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Up to four new rows inserted into feature_flags ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING; all flags disabled

execution.resumeStrategy: Rerun the single idempotent INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING statement; duplicate keys are skipped
execution.idempotency: INSERT ... VALUES ... ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING

quarantine.strategy: No tenant keys or user data are inferred, backfilled, or quarantined; only four feature-flag rows are seeded

constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: No constraints or indexes are created; the ON CONFLICT target uses the existing unique feature_flags.key

recovery.rollback: Delete the four post_styles_% flag rows in a forward migration if the family is rolled back
recovery.forwardFix: Flag lifecycle continues through the existing feature-flag governance migrations

queries: select key, enabled, rollout_percentage from public.feature_flags where key like 'post_styles_%' order by key
